column3: We are happy to share with you our list of international investors in Deep Tech (DT)!
Our mapping regroups different types of investors (VCs, CVCs, etc.) focusing exclusively or partially in deep tech.

The file is divided into multiple investment categories, in which you can find those currently active, as well 
as their geographical focus and preferred stage to invest.

Is an investor missing or with incomplete/outdated information?
This document is updated regularly. If you want to help us improve it by adding new investors, updating existing ones or if you have any comment/feedback, please fill in this form.
Learn more about our activities and services to startups, investors and corporates (events, matchmaking services, startups competitions, reports...) at www.hello-tomorrow.org or contact us.
Are you a deep tech startup? Join our free Deep Tech Pioneers community to boost your startup!
Are you a deep tech investor? Join our Investor Network to get exclusive insights, curated investment opportunities and access to our events.
We hope this mapping will be useful to you!
